description.value: Green Bamboo is a small, family-run Vietnamese noodle restaurant that has operated inside Burnaby's Crystal Mall since 2008, run by a husband-and-wife team with just 8 tables. The menu centres on house-made beef noodle soup (pho), spring rolls, vermicelli, and rice combos prepared with fresh ingredients. Located at the busy Kingsway and Willingdon intersection, it is a compact, cash-or-debit neighbourhood spot popular with regulars.
